units.source_text: 话音刚落，心爱的笛子就回到了他的手上，

en.t: As soon as the words were spoken, his beloved flute returned to his hand,

units.source_text: 之后金盔、银甲、孔雀箭、檀香木弓、威猛的戎装，等等，如雨点冰雹般陆续掉在他跟前。

en.t: Then a golden helmet, silver armor, peacock-feather arrows, a sandalwood bow, magnificent battle attire, and more fell one after another before him like raindrops and hailstones.
